descriptions.notStarted: I better go visit Chil Sung at the Korean Folk Town.
descriptions.inProgress: Chil Sung and Chil Nam are brothers living in Korean Folk Town. Chil Sung was worried that his brother Chil Nam didn't have much food with him, and asked me if I could secretly place his sack of rice on Chil Nam's stacks.
descriptions.completed: I received a sack of rice from Chil Sung, and placed it on top of a stack of rice in front of Chil Nam's house.
